text: Get lost, you bandit scum!
zh: 滚开，你这强盗败类！

text: Wait...
zh: 等等……

text: You ain't a bandit, right?
zh: 你不是强盗，对吧？

text: What's up?
zh: 什么事？

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: What are you doing here?
zh: 你在这里做什么？

text: I could help you, if you want.
zh: 需要的话，我可以帮你。

text: The bridge to the east is repaired.
zh: 东边的桥修好了。

text: I have your gold. (give 1500 gold)
zh: 我带来了你的金币。（交出1500金币）

text: I have your wares.
zh: 我拿回了你的货物。

text: What do you still need?
zh: 你还需要什么？

text: I did everything you needed.
zh: 你要的事我都办妥了。

text: See you!
zh: 回头见！

text: I am #:Lennard:#, a merchant of the Icefall Village.
zh: 我是#:伦纳德:#，冰瀑村的商人。

text: I joined a caravan, which settled to the east of here, right after the bridge.
zh: 我加入了一支商队，他们就驻扎在东边，过了桥就是。

text: I thought it was a good idea to scout the environment and sell my wares around here.
zh: 我本以为在附近勘察一下环境、顺便卖点货是个好主意。

text: Turns out, these bastards up here rather steal my stuff instead of buying it.
zh: 结果呢，山上这帮混蛋不买我的东西，反倒把货全抢了。

text: When I wanted to return to the caravan, the bridge had broken down.
zh: 等我想回商队的时候，桥又塌了。

text: Now I am stranded here without my wares and no way to go back to my people.
zh: 现在我被困在这里，货没了，也没法回到自己人身边。

text: I could help you out.
zh: 我可以帮你脱困。

text: Sounds terrible.
zh: 听起来真惨。

text: An astute observation...
zh: 观察得真够敏锐的……

text: Well, that would certainly be kind of you.
zh: 哦，那你可真是个好心人。

text:
Listen, I need my wares back.
Or at least the gold for all the goods they stole.
zh:
听着，我得拿回我的货。
或者至少要拿回他们抢走的那些货物的钱。

text: I'd place their worth around 1500 gold.
zh: 我估摸着那批货值1500金币上下。

text: Also, the bridge to the east has to be repaired.
zh: 另外，东边的桥也得修好。

text: There was one guy from another camp who was supposed to get it done, but instead of repairing the bridge he thought it more important to go fishing!
zh: 本来另一个营地有个家伙负责修桥，结果他倒好，觉得钓鱼比修桥更要紧！

text: Please, just hurry up and get this done, so I can finally return to the caravan.
zh: 拜托，赶紧把这些事办妥吧，好让我能回到商队去。

text:
That is some good news.
How did you get the lazy guy to repair it?
zh:
真是个好消息。
你是怎么让那个懒鬼去修桥的？

text:
Nevermind.
I think, I already know the answer.
zh:
算了。
我想我已经知道答案了。

text:
Thank you so much!
How did you get the gold from these bandits?
zh:
太感谢你了！
你是怎么从那帮强盗手里弄到金币的？

text: Actually, I don't care for the methods.
zh: 其实，我才不在乎你用的什么法子。

text:
Thank you so much!
How did you get the wares back from these bandits?
zh:
太感谢你了！
你是怎么从那帮强盗手里把货拿回来的？

text: Let me think...
zh: 让我想想……

text:
I still need my wares.
They should be around here somewhere.
zh:
我还需要拿回我的货。
它们应该就在这附近的什么地方。

text:
The bridge to the east has to be repaired.
Otherwise, I would not be able to return to the caravan.
zh:
东边的桥得修好。
不然我就没法回到商队了。

text: That's all.
zh: 就这些。

text: Meet me at the caravan. We can talk about your payment there.
zh: 到商队那儿找我。我们可以在那里谈谈你的报酬。

text: Thank you so much for everything, friend!
zh: 朋友，这一切真是太感谢你了！
